## ChatOSS v1.17.0

Launch mode's spawn pause is now a **setup card**: one row per agent, each with its own coding CLI, model and reasoning effort.

### Per-agent CLI + model + effort

When **Settings → Launch → Default coding CLI** is "Ask every time", starting terminal agents pauses **once** and shows a card with **a row per agent** — its name, its task (click to expand the full prompt), and its own **CLI**, **model** and **effort** pickers. A **Set all** row applies one choice to every agent in a click.

Each row arrives pre-filled with exactly what that agent would have run anyway: the model + effort from your Settings → Launch complexity tiers, and the CLI the Launch agent suggested. Press Start and nothing changes; edit only the rows you care about.

This replaces a single free-text question. That question could only ever choose a CLI — never a per-agent model or effort — and its answer had to follow a grammar you had to guess: a perfectly reasonable *"OpenCode for whatever is the simplest, Claude Code for the rest"* named no agent in the batch, failed to parse, and cancelled the whole spawn. The card answers with structured data, so there is nothing to parse and nothing to misread.

Unchanged: the card appears **only** with "Ask every time" — set a concrete default CLI and agents still start with no pause at all.

### Fixes
- **Typing in the composer while a spawn card is up no longer strands the turn.** The sub-agent (Orchestrate) and terminal-agent (Launch) spawn cards resolve their own pause, so a typed message used to queue behind a turn that waited forever. Typing now cancels the card and your message starts a fresh turn.
- **A pre-selected model that isn't in your saved list is no longer silently swapped.** If a Settings complexity tier pointed at a model that wasn't in the picker's catalog, the dropdown rendered blank and quietly submitted the first entry instead. Both spawn cards now always offer the pre-selected model.
- **The effort control no longer shows the previous model's levels** for a model that cannot think.
- A spawn spec that can't launch at all (an unknown CLI name, a missing prompt) no longer takes up a row on the card — it is reported as an error instead of spending your one decision on an agent about to be rejected.

After updating, reinstall the `chatoss` command from **Settings → Launch** if you use Launch mode from a terminal (the bundled CLI is refreshed with the app; a stale copy elsewhere on PATH is not).
